title: no orca on PATH fails the orca check with the install link; an ORCA_CLI_COMMAND that names no executable is named
source: intended: the doctor orca failure carries the install hint
intent: With no orca on PATH (minimal system PATH, ORCA_CLI_COMMAND empty) doctor prints `fail orca: orca is not on PATH; install Orca from https://github.com/stablyai/orca and open it once` and exits 3. With ORCA_CLI_COMMAND set to a missing program it names the variable and the value. Doctor never runs orca.

stdout.regex: (?m)^fail orca: orca is not on PATH; install Orca from https://github\.com/stablyai/orca and open it once$
(?m)^fail orca: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND is set to \Q{{BIN}}\E/no-orca, which is not an executable on PATH$
